'''Shadda silk''' was a material sourced from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shadda-Bi-Boran/Legends|Shadda-Bi-Boran]], inhabited by the [[Shadda-Bi-Boran (species)|Shadda-Bi-Boran]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Towards the end of the [[Great Peace of the Republic]], [[Astrophysicist/Legends|astrophysicists]] predicted that the planet's [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarf]] [[Star/Legends|sun]], [[Shadda (star)|Shadda]], would cease providing enough [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] to prevent Shadda-Bi-Boran from [[Temperature/Legends|freezing]] over. This endangered the Shadda-Bi-Borans, who depended on their sun to activate an enzyme that purified toxins from their bodies.<ref name="TEA" />

As a result, kerchiefs and armbands made of Shadda [[Silk/Legends|silk]] were sold in fundraising efforts. The proceeds were divided between research to artificially trigger the enzyme and the search for another star that could support the Shadda-Bi-Borans. The Shadda silk kerchiefs and armbands became essential expressions of sympathy in wealthy circles throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Ultimately, the efforts to save the Shadda-Bi-Borans were unsuccessful.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shadda silk was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" />
